Allure's channel is focused on bringing beauty to life with unparalleled expertise, smart storytelling, and radical inclusivity.


Subscribe to the Allure channel here: http://www.youtube.com/channel/UCb0tMboxhHE8Jx6-nhJmRPw?sub_confirmation=1
Visit the Allure channel for more video: http://www.youtube.com/allure
Visit Allure Videos for more: http://video.allure.com
Visit Allure at http://www.allure.com
